Well, I found out there's actually alternatives to sysvinit, so I'm investigating those routes at the moment
OS X uses a thing called "launchd" which sounds nice, and isn't a GNU program
The goal is to have some form of script or something which runs at startup and loads all the drivers necessary for the system (ie, a bunch of modload invocations) to function
That way the initrd can just contain a tiny subset of modules and drivers and those people want can be loaded later
For example, the network stack and network drivers should probably be loaded outside of kernel startup, and only if the user says "Yes, enable networking"
